```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

check_and_install_packages <- function(){

  packages <- c('anytime', 'dplyr', 'ggplot2', 'ggpattern', 'ggtext', 'ggthemes',
                'grid', 'htmltools', 'httr', 'jsonlite', 'kableExtra', 'png',
                'readxl', 'reticulate', 'rvest', 'scotustext', 'stringi',
                'stringr', 'tidyr', 'tm', 'webshot2', 'purrr', 'tibble', 'httr', 'httr2',
                'tokenizers', 'lubridate', 'scales', 'forcats', 'patchwork', 'openxlsx', 'readxl')

  missing_packages <- packages[!packages %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]

  # If there are missing packages
  if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
    message("The following necessary packages are missing: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))

    response <- readline("Would you like to install them? (Y/N): ")
    if (tolower(response) %in% c("yes", "y")) {
      install.packages(missing_packages, dependencies = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
      message("Packages installed successfully.")
    } else {
      stop("Packages must be installed prior to compilation. Please install and try again.")
    }
  }

  invisible(lapply(packages, function(pkg) {
    suppressWarnings(suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)))
  }))

  message('All Packages Installed and Deployed Correctly')
} # Check and Install Necessary Packages
check_and_install_packages() # Deploy
```

```{r setup2, include = F}
cases_master <- read.csv('../../cases_master/cases_master_file_OT25.csv', as.is = T)

scotusblog_stats_files <- list.files('../../scotusblog_replication/data', full.names = F)

for (i in 1:length(scotusblog_stats_files)){
  temp_stat <- scotusblog_stats_files[i]
  temp_stat_name <- gsub('\\.xlsx', '', temp_stat)
  temp_sheets <- excel_sheets(file.path('../../scotusblog_replication/data', temp_stat))
  df_list <- lapply(temp_sheets, function(s) {
  read_excel(path = file.path('../../scotusblog_replication/data', temp_stat), sheet = s)
})
  names(df_list) <- temp_sheets
  scotusblog_stats[[as.character(temp_stat_name)]] <- df_list
}

escape_latex <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\textbackslash{}", x)
  x <- gsub("&", "\\\\&", x)
  x <- gsub("%", "\\\\%", x)
  x <- gsub("\\$", "\\\\$", x)
  x <- gsub("#", "\\\\#", x)
  x <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", x)
  x <- gsub("\\{", "\\\\{", x)
  x <- gsub("\\}", "\\\\}", x)
  x
}
```

```{=latex}
\begin{figure}

    \includegraphics[width=0.65\linewidth]{../../scotusblog_replication/figures/decisions_over_time.png}
    \label{fig:opinions_over_time}
\end{figure}

\footernote{
\textbf{Notes:} (1) Figure shows the volume \& proportion of opinions (by type) authored by the Court between the 2005 and 2025 terms. Data from earlier terms were retrieved from the \href{https://scdb.la.psu.edu/}{Supreme Court Database}. Opinions delivered \emph{per curiam} are coded as a majority opinion, while special concurrences (\emph{in part}) and those concurring in judgment are both coded as concurrences. (2) The Stat Pack only focuses on ``Opinions of the Court'' and not ``Opinions Relating to Orders,'' the latter of which includes several of the cases on the emergency docket. (3) \emph{Goldey v. Fields} (24-809) was decided \emph{per curiam} on June 30, 2025 and was not included in the OT2024-25 Stat Pack. 
}
```

<!-- Strength of the Majority -->

```{r strength_of_majority_tables, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis', echo=F}

justices <- scotusblog_stats$frequency_in_majority$perc_opinions_unanimous$justice 

df <- scotusblog_stats$frequency_in_majority$coalition_sizesjustice %>%
  setNames(c('Justice', 'Total Opinions', 'Unanimous', '(8-1)', '(7-2)', '(6-3)', '(5-4)', 'Average Majority Size')) %>%
  bind_rows(
    summarise(.,
              Justice = "Total",
              across(`Total Opinions`:`(5-4)`, sum, na.rm = TRUE),
              `Average Majority Size` = mean(as.numeric(`Average Majority Size`), na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  mutate(`Average Majority Size` = round(`Average Majority Size`, 2))

names(df)[1] <- ''

k <- kableExtra::kbl(df,
                     format = "latex",
                     linesep = '', 
                     booktabs = TRUE,
                     align = c('l', rep('c', 7)))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
  if (i %% 2 == 0) {
    k <- kableExtra::row_spec(k, i, background = "#F5F5F5")
  }
}

t1 <- k %>% 
  kableExtra::row_spec(9, extra_latex_after = '\\midrule\\vspace{-5mm}') %>%
  kableExtra::row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  kableExtra::row_spec(10, bold = TRUE) %>%
  kableExtra::column_spec(1, bold = TRUE)


df <- data.frame(Justice = justices) %>% 
  left_join(scotusblog_stats$frequency_in_majority$solo_dissents_current_term %>%
              group_by(Justice) %>%
  summarise(case_count =  n(),
    case_names = paste0(short_hand, collapse = ", " ), .groups = "drop") %>%
              mutate(Justice = str_to_title(Justice)) , 
  by = 'Justice') %>%
  mutate(case_count = ifelse(is.na(case_count), '', as.character(case_count)), 
         case_names = ifelse(is.na(case_names), '', as.character(case_names))) %>%
  setNames(c('', 'OT25', 'Case(s)')) 



k <-  kableExtra::kbl(df, 
                      booktabs = TRUE,
                      linesep = '', 
                  longtable = F,
                  align = c('c', 'c', 'l')) %>%
  kableExtra::column_spec(1, width = "3cm", bold = TRUE) %>%
  kableExtra::column_spec(3, width = "10cm") %>%
  kableExtra::row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, align = 'c')
  
for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
  if (i %% 2 == 0) {
    k <- kableExtra::row_spec(k, i, background = "#F5F5F5")
  }
}

t2 <- k 

gorsuch_unanimous <- scotusblog_stats$frequency_in_majority$coalition_sizesjustice[scotusblog_stats$frequency_in_majority$coalition_sizesjustice$justice == 'Gorsuch',]$maj_9
gorsuch_7_2 <- scotusblog_stats$frequency_in_majority$coalition_sizesjustice[scotusblog_stats$frequency_in_majority$coalition_sizesjustice$justice == 'Gorsuch',]$maj_7
gorsuch_opinions <- scotusblog_stats$frequency_in_majority$coalition_sizesjustice[scotusblog_stats$frequency_in_majority$coalition_sizesjustice$justice == 'Gorsuch',]$total_opinions
gorsuch_mean <- scotusblog_stats$frequency_in_majority$coalition_sizesjustice[scotusblog_stats$frequency_in_majority$coalition_sizesjustice$justice == 'Gorsuch',]$mean_coalition

jackson_solo <- data.frame(Justice = justices) %>% 
  left_join(scotusblog_stats$frequency_in_majority$solo_dissents_current_term %>%
              group_by(Justice) %>%
  summarise(case_count =  n(),
    case_names = paste0(short_hand, collapse = ", " ), .groups = "drop") %>%
              mutate(Justice = str_to_title(Justice)) , 
  by = 'Justice') %>%
  filter(Justice == "Jackson") 

side_text <- paste0("
\\textbf{Description (Above)}: Table above provides an overview of coalition types given different Justices authoring majority opinions. For example, of the ", gorsuch_opinions, " majority opinions authored by Justice Neil Gorsuch, ", gorsuch_unanimous  ," are opinions representing a unanimous Court -- while ", gorsuch_7_2, " of his majority opinions are in cases decided by a (7-2) Court. On average, Justice Gorsuch's opinions represented majorities of approximately ", gorsuch_mean ," Justices. \\par \\vspace{2.5mm}

\\textbf{Description (Below)}: Table below stratifies opinions decided in OT25 to those decided with a single dissenting Justice. For example, Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson was the sole dissenter in ", jackson_solo$case_count, " case(s) this term (\\emph{", paste(jackson_solo$case_names, collapse = ', '), "})

\\vspace{4mm}

\\textbf{Notes}: (1) Only cases where a sole dissenter authored an opinion are included. For instance, Justice Jackson's preference to have denied certiorari in \\emph{Klein v. Martin} (25-51) is not included because it does not include a written opinion. (2) Moreover, only cases with a signed majority opinion are included in this analysis – cases decided \\emph{per curiam} with no signed majority opinion are omitted.
")
```

<!-- Closely Divided Cases -->

```{r closely_divided_cases, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis', echo=F}

justices <- scotusblog_stats$frequency_in_majority$perc_opinions_unanimous$justice 

closely_divided_cases_conditons <- list()

{
  
  ideological_split <- scotusblog_stats$coalitions$ot25_coalitions %>%
    filter(majority_sorted == 'Roberts, Alito, Thomas, Gorsuch, Kavanaugh, Barrett') %>%
    mutate(condition = "6-3 with Justices Sotomayor, Kagan, and Jackson Dissenting",  
             percent_all_cases = round(count/nrow(cases_master)*100, 0), 
           percent_all_cases = paste0(percent_all_cases, '%')) %>%
    select(condition, percent_all_cases, case)
  

} # 6-3 -- Libs v. Cons

{
  
  thomas_alito_gorsuch_dissent <- scotusblog_stats$coalitions$ot25_coalitions %>%
    filter(str_count(majority_sorted, ", ") + 1 == 6) %>%
    filter(!grepl('Thomas', majority_sorted)) %>%
    filter(!grepl('Alito', majority_sorted)) %>%
    filter(!grepl('Gorsuch', majority_sorted)) %>%
    mutate(condition = "6-3 with Justices Thomas, Alito, and Gorsuch Dissenting", 
           percent_all_cases = as.character('0%')) 
  
  if (!nrow(thomas_alito_gorsuch_dissent) == 0){
    thomas_alito_gorsuch_dissent <- thomas_alito_gorsuch_dissent %>%
      mutate(percent_all_cases = round(count/nrow(cases_master)*100, 0), 
             percent_all_cases = paste0(percent_all_cases, '%')) %>%
    select(condition, percent_all_cases, case)
  } else {
    thomas_alito_gorsuch_dissent <- data.frame('condition' =  "6-3 with Justices Thomas, Alito, and Gorsuch Dissenting", 
           'percent_all_cases' = as.character('0%'), 
           'case' = '')
  }
  

} # 6-3 -- Thomas Alito Gorsuch Dissent

{
  
  liberal_justices <- c("Sotomayor", "Kagan", "Jackson")
  
  sotomayor_kagan_jackson_all_dissent <- scotusblog_stats$coalitions$ot25_coalitions %>%
    mutate(n_missing_liberals = purrr::map_int(str_split(majority_sorted, ", "),
      ~ length(setdiff(liberal_justices, .x)))) %>%
    filter(n_missing_liberals == 3) %>%
    mutate(condition = "Cases with Justices Sotomayor, Kagan, and Jackson All Dissenting",
           percent_all_cases = as.character('0%')) 

if (nrow(sotomayor_kagan_jackson_all_dissent) != 0) {
  sotomayor_kagan_jackson_all_dissent <- sotomayor_kagan_jackson_all_dissent %>%
    summarise(case = paste(case, collapse = ", "),
              case = gsub('\\;', ',', case), 
                count = sum(count)) %>%
    mutate(percent_all_cases = round(count / nrow(cases_master) * 100, 0),
           percent_all_cases = paste0(percent_all_cases, "%"), 
           condition = "Cases with Justices Sotomayor, Kagan, and Jackson All in Dissent") %>%
    select(condition, percent_all_cases, case) 
}
  

} # Sotomayor Kagan Jackson all in dissent (Not Just 6-3)

{
  
  conservatives <- c('Roberts', 'Thomas', 'Alito', 'Gorsuch', 'Kavanaugh', 'Barrett')
  conservative_dissenters <- scotusblog_stats$coalitions$ot25_coalitions %>%
    mutate(missing_conservatives = purrr::map_chr(str_split(majority_sorted, ", "),
      ~ paste(setdiff(conservatives, .x), collapse = ", ")),
    n_missing_conservatives = purrr::map_int(str_split(majority_sorted, ", "),
      ~ length(setdiff(conservatives, .x)))) %>%
  filter(n_missing_conservatives >= 3) %>% 
    select(-c(n_missing_conservatives, missing_conservatives)) %>%
    summarise(case = paste(case, collapse = ", "), 
                count = sum(count)) %>%
    mutate(condition = "Cases with Three or More Conservative Justices Dissenting", 
           percent_all_cases = as.character('0%')) 
      
  
  if (!nrow(conservative_dissenters) == 0){
    conservative_dissenters <- conservative_dissenters %>%
      mutate(percent_all_cases = round(count/nrow(cases_master)*100, 0), 
             percent_all_cases = paste0(percent_all_cases, '%')) %>%
    select(condition, percent_all_cases, case)
  }
  
} # 3 Or More Conservative Justices Dissenting


combined <- ideological_split %>%
  bind_rows(thomas_alito_gorsuch_dissent) %>%
  bind_rows(sotomayor_kagan_jackson_all_dissent) %>%
  bind_rows(conservative_dissenters) %>%

  setNames(c('Condition', 'Percent of All Cases', 'Cases')) %>%
  mutate(Cases = gsub('\\;', ',', Cases)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ {
    .x %>%
      str_replace_all("%", "\\\\%") %>%
      str_replace_all("&", "\\\\&") %>%
      str_replace_all("_", "\\\\_") %>%
      str_replace_all("#", "\\\\#") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\$", "\\\\$")
  }))

k <- k %>%
```

# Opinions Authored by Each Justice

```{r opinion_authored_by_each_justice, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}


all_justices <- c('Roberts', 'Thomas', 'Alito', 'Sotomayor', 'Kagan', 'Gorsuch', 'Kavanaugh', 'Barrett', 'Jackson' )

make_wide <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(Justice) %>%
    mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Justice, row_id, Case) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Justice, values_from = Case) %>%
    select(-row_id) %>%
    { 
      missing_cols <- setdiff(all_justices, names(.))
      for (col in missing_cols) .[[col]] <- NA
      .[, all_justices]
    }
}

majorities <- scotusblog_stats$opinions$opinions_by_justice %>%
  filter(Opinion_Type == "Majority") %>%
  make_wide()

dissents <- scotusblog_stats$opinions$opinions_by_justice %>%
  filter(Opinion_Type == "Dissent") %>%
  make_wide()

concurrences <- scotusblog_stats$opinions$opinions_by_justice %>%
  filter(!Opinion_Type %in% c("Majority", "Dissent")) %>%
  make_wide()

majorities <- majorities %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, ""))) %>%
  kbl(format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      linesep = '', 
      longtable = TRUE,
      escape = TRUE, 
      align = 'c') %>%
  add_header_above(c("Majority Opinions" = 9)) %>%
  kable_styling(
    font_size = 9,
    latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header")
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1:9, width = "3cm") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = T)

concurrences <- concurrences %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, ""))) %>%
  kbl(format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      linesep = '', 
      longtable = TRUE,
      escape = TRUE, 
      align = 'c') %>%
  add_header_above(c("Concurring Opinions" = 9)) %>%
  kable_styling(
    font_size = 9,
    latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header")
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1:9, width = "3cm") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = T)

dissents <- dissents %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, ""))) %>%
  kbl(format = "latex",
      booktabs = TRUE,
      linesep = '', 
      longtable = TRUE,
      escape = TRUE, 
      align = 'c') %>%
  add_header_above(c("Dissenting Opinions" = 9)) %>%
  kable_styling(
    font_size = 9,
    latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header")
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1:9, width = "3cm") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = T)

t1 <- gsub("\\\\bottomrule", "", as.character(majorities))
t2 <- gsub("\\\\bottomrule", "", as.character(concurrences))
t3 <- as.character(dissents)


cat(t1)
cat("\\vspace{-0.75cm}")

cat(t2)
cat("\\vspace{-0.75cm}")

cat(t3)
```

```{R opinion_lengths, echo=FALSE, results = 'asis'}
scotusblog_stats$opinion_lengths$shortest_opinions %>%
  bind_rows(scotusblog_stats$opinion_lengths$longest_opinions) %>%
  mutate(type = c('', 'Shortest', '(Individual Opinions)', '', '', '', 'Longest', '(Individual Opinions)', '', '')) %>%
  select(type, short_hand, opinion_type, authorship, coalition, word_count, date_decided) %>%
  bind_rows(
    scotusblog_stats$opinion_lengths$combined_opinion_lengths %>%
      arrange(desc(total_words)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      transmute(
        opinion_type = paste0('(', total_opinions, ' Opinions', ')'),
        short_hand = case_name,
        coalition = coalition,
        date_decided = date_decided,
        authorship = total_authors,
        word_count = total_words
      ) %>%
      mutate(type = c('', '', '', '', 'Longest', '(Total Combined)', '', '', '', ''))) %>%
  mutate(word_count = scales::comma(word_count), 
         coalition = ifelse(coalition == 'Per Curiam', 'PC', coalition)) %>%
  setNames(c('', 'Case', 'Opinion Type (Total Opinions)', 'Author(s)', 'Vote', 'Word Count', 'Decided')) %>%
```

```{R voting_alignment, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}

voting_alignment <- decisions[,-c(1, 2, 4)] %>%
  left_join(cases_master, by = c('Docket' = 'docket')) %>%
  select(short_hand, Date_Decided, Coalition, Author, SOTOMAYOR, KAGAN, JACKSON, ROBERTS, KAVANAUGH, BARRETT, GORSUCH, ALITO, THOMAS) %>%
  rename(
    `Case Name` = short_hand,
    Decided = Date_Decided,
    Vote = Coalition) %>%
  mutate(Vote = ifelse(Vote == 'Per Curiam', 'PC', Vote), 
         Author = ifelse(Author == 'Per Curiam', 'PC', Author))

notes <- decisions[,-c(1, 2, 4)] %>%
  left_join(cases_master, by = c('Docket' = 'docket')) %>%
  select(short_hand, Date_Decided, Notes)

justice_cols <- names(voting_alignment)[
  names(voting_alignment) %in% c(
    "ROBERTS","THOMAS","ALITO","SOTOMAYOR","KAGAN",
    "GORSUCH","KAVANAUGH","BARRETT","JACKSON"
  )
]


voting_alignment <- voting_alignment %>%
  mutate(across(
    all_of(justice_cols),
    ~ cell_spec(
      " ",
      background = case_when(
        is.na(.) ~ "white",
        . %in% c(2, 4, 5, 7) ~ "#70ac47",
        . %in% c(1, 100, 999) ~ "#4f4789",
        TRUE ~ "#ff0000"
      ),
      color = case_when(
        is.na(.) ~ "white",
        . %in% c(2, 4, 5, 7) ~ "#70ac47",
        . %in% c(1, 100, 999) ~ "#4f4789",
        TRUE ~ "#ff0000"
      ),
      escape = FALSE
    )
  ))


justice_image_paths <- c(
  ROBERTS   = "../../../../data/justice_images/Roberts.png",
  THOMAS    = "../../../../data/justice_images/Thomas.png",
  ALITO     = "../../../../data/justice_images/Alito.png",
  SOTOMAYOR = "../../../../data/justice_images/Sotomayor.png",
  KAGAN     = "../../../../data/justice_images/Kagan.png",
  GORSUCH   = "../../../../data/justice_images/Gorsuch.png",
  KAVANAUGH = "../../../../data/justice_images/Kavanaugh.png",
  BARRETT   = "../../../../data/justice_images/Barrett.png",
  JACKSON   = "../../../../data/justice_images/Jackson.png"
)


justice_labels_html <- paste0(
  "<img src='", justice_image_paths[justice_cols],
  "' style='width:50px;height:50px;' />"
)

justice_labels_latex <- paste0(
    "\\makebox[0pt][c]{\\includegraphics[width=1.5in,height=1.5in]{",
    justice_image_paths[justice_cols],
    "}}"
  )


if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  justice_labels <- justice_labels_latex
} else {
  justice_labels <- justice_labels_html
}

colnames(voting_alignment)[match(justice_cols, names(voting_alignment))] <- justice_labels

filtered_notes <- notes %>%
  filter(!is.na(Notes)) %>%
  filter(!Notes == '') %>%
  arrange(Date_Decided) %>%
  mutate(note_id = row_number())

notes_latex <- filtered_notes %>%
  arrange(note_id) %>%
  mutate(Notes = escape_latex(Notes)) %>%
  mutate(line = paste0('(',note_id, ") ", Notes)) %>%
  pull(line) %>%
  paste(collapse = "\n\n")

notes_latex <- paste0('\n\n', notes_latex)


voting_alignment <- voting_alignment %>%
  left_join(filtered_notes %>% select(short_hand, note_id), by = c("Case Name" = "short_hand")) %>%
  mutate(
    `Case Name` = ifelse(
      !is.na(note_id),
      paste0(`Case Name`, "\\textsuperscript{(", note_id, ")}"),
      `Case Name`
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-c(note_id)) %>%
  arrange(Decided) 


tbl <- voting_alignment %>% 
  mutate(.row_id = row_number()) %>%
  mutate(across(
    names(voting_alignment)[1:4],
    ~ cell_spec(
        .,
        background = ifelse(.row_id %% 2 == 0, "#f7f7f7", "white"),
        escape = FALSE
    ))) %>%
    select(-c(.row_id)) %>%
  kbl(format = "latex",
      longtable = T,
      escape = FALSE,
      align = rep('c', 10),
      linesep = '', 
      booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = F,
                position = "center",
                font_size = 11,
                latex_options = c('repeat_header')) %>%
  column_spec(5:ncol(voting_alignment), width = "0.75in") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, align = "c")  %>%
  column_spec(13, border_right = TRUE) %>% 
  column_spec(5, border_left = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(
    1:nrow(voting_alignment)-1,
    extra_latex_after = "\\addlinespace[0.3em]") 


tbl <- gsub("\\\\toprule\\s*", "", tbl)

cat(tbl)

```

```{r, term_index, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
sittings_1 <- c('October Sitting', rep(' ', 5),

              'Totals', rep(' ', 5))

temp_cols <- c(rbind(
  paste0("short_hand", 1:3),
  paste0("author", 1:3),
  paste0("vote", 1:3), 
  paste0("days_elapsed", 1:3), 
  paste0("decision", 1:3), 
  paste0("lower_court", 1:3)
))

{
  
  sitting_1_rows <- max(
    nrow(scotusblog_stats$term_index$October), 
    nrow(scotusblog_stats$term_index$November), 
    nrow(scotusblog_stats$term_index$December)
  )
  
  sitting_1_df <- data.frame(

      grepl('Vacate', decision) ~ 'V', 
      grepl('Reverse', decision)~ 'R', 
      grepl('(Grant|Granted|GRR)', decision, decision)~ 'G', 
      grepl('DIG', decision) ~ 'DIG'), 
      days_elapsed = paste0(days_elapsed, 'd'),

combined_sittings <- bind_rows(scotusblog_stats$term_index)

totals <- t(data.frame('Signed' = nrow(combined_sittings[!combined_sittings$author == 'Per Curiam' & 
                                                           !is.na(combined_sittings$author),]), 
             'PC' = nrow(combined_sittings[combined_sittings$author == 'Per Curiam' & !is.na(combined_sittings$author),])) %>%
    mutate('Total' = sum(Signed, PC), 
           'Blank' = '', 
           'Argued' = nrow(combined_sittings[!combined_sittings$sitting == 'No Argument',]), 
           'No Argument' = nrow(combined_sittings[combined_sittings$sitting == 'No Argument',]), 
           'Dismissed' = nrow(combined_sittings[combined_sittings$decision %in% c('DIG', 'D', 'Dismissed'),]), 
           'Blank 2' = '') %>%
      mutate('Expected' = sum(Argued, `No Argument`, Dismissed))) 
row_names <- c('Opinions of the Court (Signed)', 
                      'Opinions of the Court (Per Curiam)', 
                      ' ',
                      'Total Opinions Released', 
                      'Cases Granted for Argument', 
                      'Cases Decided Without Argument', 
                      'Cases Dismissed After Argument', 
                      ' ',
                      'Total Opinions Expected')

  mutate(V1 = row_names) %>%
  relocate(V1)
```
